Pelagic and Demersal Species Groups

Source: R/pelagic_demersal.R
fao_pd_groups.Rd

This function lists the ISSCAAP species groups of marine fishes and crustaceans, and how each is counted by the two definitions of pelagic_demersal(): "pelagic", "demersal" or "not counted". ISSCAAP groups not listed (molluscs, diadromous and freshwater fishes, mammals, plants, other invertebrates) are not counted by either definition.

Usage

fao_pd_groups()

Value

A data frame with one row per group: isscaap_code, isscaap_en (the name used in the FAO data), de_leiva_moreno and grainger_garcia.

References

Caddy, J.F. (1993). Toward a comparative evaluation of human impacts on fishery ecosystems of enclosed and semi-enclosed seas. Reviews in Fisheries Science 1: 57-95. doi:10.1080/10641269309388535

Caddy, J.F., Carocci, F. and Coppola, S. (1998). Have peak fishery production levels been passed in continental shelf area? Some perspectives arising from historical trends in production per shelf area. Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science 23: 191-219. doi:10.2960/J.v23.a13

de Leiva Moreno, J.I., Agostini, V.N., Caddy, J.F. and Carocci, F. (2000). Is the pelagic-demersal ratio from fishery landings a useful proxy for nutrient availability? A preliminary data exploration for the semi-enclosed seas around Europe. ICES Journal of Marine Science 57: 1091-1102. doi:10.1006/jmsc.2000.0705

Grainger, R.J.R. and Garcia, S.M. (1996). Chronicles of marine fishery landings (1950-1994): trend analysis and fisheries potential. FAO Fisheries Technical Paper 359. Rome: FAO. https://www.fao.org/4/w3244e/w3244e00.htm

Hondorp, D.W., Breitburg, D.L. and Davias, L.A. (2010). Eutrophication and fisheries: separating the effects of nitrogen loads and hypoxia on the pelagic-to-demersal ratio and other measures of landings composition. Marine and Coastal Fisheries 2: 339-361. doi:10.1577/C09-020.1

Examples

fao_pd_groups()
#>    isscaap_code                       isscaap_en de_leiva_moreno
#> 1            31       Flounders, halibuts, soles        demersal
#> 2            32            Cods, hakes, haddocks        demersal
#> 3            33     Miscellaneous coastal fishes        demersal
#> 4            34    Miscellaneous demersal fishes        demersal
#> 5            35    Herrings, sardines, anchovies         pelagic
#> 6            36       Tunas, bonitos, billfishes     not counted
#> 7            37     Miscellaneous pelagic fishes     not counted
#> 8            38          Sharks, rays, chimaeras     not counted
#> 9            39     Marine fishes not identified     not counted
#> 10           42               Crabs, sea-spiders        demersal
#> 11           43    Lobsters, spiny-rock lobsters        demersal
#> 12           44       King crabs, squat-lobsters        demersal
#> 13           45                  Shrimps, prawns        demersal
#> 14           46    Krill, planktonic crustaceans     not counted
#> 15           47 Miscellaneous marine crustaceans        demersal
#>    grainger_garcia
#> 1         demersal
#> 2         demersal
#> 3         demersal
#> 4         demersal
#> 5          pelagic
#> 6          pelagic
#> 7          pelagic
#> 8         demersal
#> 9         demersal
#> 10     not counted
#> 11     not counted
#> 12     not counted
#> 13     not counted
#> 14     not counted
#> 15     not counted
